name: 20' Dry Standard
notes: General cargo; best for heavy, dense loads such as machinery parts, metals or bagged goods.

name: 40' Dry Standard
notes: General cargo; double the floor of a 20' for bulky but not tall goods.

name: 40' High Cube
notes: Light, voluminous cargo such as furniture, textiles or consumer goods; extra 0.3 m of height.

name: 45' High Cube
notes: Maximum-volume light cargo; check road length limits before inland delivery.

name: 20' Reefer
notes: Dense temperature-controlled cargo such as frozen meat, fish or pharmaceuticals.

name: 40' Reefer High Cube
notes: Main reefer workhorse for chilled and frozen produce, meat and dairy.

name: 20' Open Top
notes: Over-height or crane-loaded heavy cargo such as machinery, stone or timber; tarpaulin roof.

name: 40' Open Top
notes: Long over-height or top-loaded cargo such as pipes, steel or machinery.

name: 20' Flat Rack (collapsible)
notes: Heavy or out-of-gauge cargo such as vehicles, generators or machinery; loaded from top or sides.

name: 40' Flat Rack (collapsible, high cube)
notes: Long, heavy or out-of-gauge cargo such as boats, construction equipment or steel structures.

name: 20' ISO Tank (T11)
notes: Bulk liquids such as chemicals, food-grade oils or beverages; fill typically 80-95% of capacity.

name: 40' Platform
notes: Very heavy or oversized single pieces such as transformers or yachts; no walls or ends.
